subject: Fix build script to work when directory path contains spaces (#453)
reason: The change only quotes paths and restructures argument passing in build.sh, scripts/common.rc and submodules/CMakeLists.txt so the build works when the directory path contains spaces. It touches no module source code, no command handling, no replies, no persistence or replication path: the produced module binary behaves identically at the change and at its parent, so there is no runtime behaviour for a scenario to reach. It is a pure build/CI change and needs no test.
